method: Hand-labelled by eye: first pass from 10 fps contact sheets, then re-labelled frame by frame from native 60 fps strips around each cut. Each time is the first frame of the new shot (or of the flash that covers the cut). Two early labels were wrong and are corrected: 2.30 is a flash accent, not a jump cut, and the 1.75-2.15 flashes are deliberate object white-outs, not stutter.
